title: Apply outcome
description: POST /apply reply, and each entry of a plan's outcomes. Also the body of a blocked (422) or conflicting (409) apply.

consequence.description: What the subject is left holding.

username.description: The derived or bound account name.

uid.description: The target's stable identity for the account.

fingerprint.description: The subject's state the outcome was computed against (plan) or left in (apply).

observed.description: The managed fields as the TARGET reported them after the write; absent when unverified.

unverified.description: The mutation landed and its result could not be read.

BindingConflict.description: An unbound target account already holds the derived name.

adoptable.description: No other subject is bound to the account.
